name: Context-Gated Multi-Topology Hyperposition
parent: HYP-RC4 Clay-Native Typed Semantic Firebreak Hyperposition
laws: one semantic relation != one propagation edge != one invalidation edge != one process link != one authority path
higher-order identity may remain persistent while propagation is sparse context-gated and operation-specific
native higher-order representation is not mandatory when a simpler lowering is proven semantically equivalent
UNKNOWN dependency closure broadens or escalates; it never silently becomes KNOWN_VALID

topologies.selection: benchmark + contention + recovery + crash_radius + energy + platform

topologies.rule: selectability, propagation, model uptake and semantic colocation never mint capability authority

contextual_alternatives.rule: canonical alternatives may coexist with explicit context predicates/facets; active projection does not overwrite alternatives
contextual_alternatives.compile: operation context -> active semantic slice -> propagation/dependency/selection topology
contextual_alternatives.fallback: static union/global validation only as conservative broadening

reduction_policy.pairwise_direct: use when semantics are intrinsically pairwise
reduction_policy.weighted_pairwise: use only with operation-specific equivalence evidence
reduction_policy.relation_node_incidence: preferred lossless graph lowering for many n-ary relations
reduction_policy.native_hyperrelation: use when simpler/cheaper or when reduction proof unavailable
reduction_policy.lossy_projection: must emit explicit loss/selection receipt and cannot silently justify effect-critical reasoning

nested_workspace_boundary: system WorkspaceEpisode and model-internal privileged uptake are separate causal levels joined by a receipted projection/uptake bridge
emergence_boundary: higher-order structure, critical-like dynamics or nested workspaces do not imply emergence or phenomenal consciousness; E-CERT2 remains required
